name: Cool Story Bro!
storyline:
Write short stories about 4 random words:

Get four completely random words — like: Baguette. Insolvency. Grandpa. University

They probably don’t belong together... But that’s the point!
Turn weird word combinations into short stories and surprise your friends with creativity, chaos, or pure nonsense...

Rate the Stories:
When the writing timer ends, it’s showtime: Each player steps onto the stage and reads their masterpiece aloud!
The others vote:

Upvote = Good
Downvote = Bad
Or pull out the Rocket Launcher and blow your friend up if you REALLY hate the story!
Creative criticism has never been this explosive!

Talk to the other Players with the Ingame VoiceChat and have fun evenings together!
summary: Cool Story Bro! is a chaotic 2 - 4 player party game where you write short stories based on 4 random words. Vote for the most creative masterpiece, sabotage your friends with items, survive unexpected game - changing events… and if you really hate someone’s story? Just... Blow. Them. Up!
